checklist_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-C - Activation Security & Incident Governance Checklist

activation_guard_verifications.detail: Rejects None or empty authorization token immediately.
HMAC-SHA256 constant-time digest comparison blocks tampered tokens.
Tokens past expiry_utc timestamp rejected immediately.
Exact binding to agent.py (46e68dc9...) and universe.json (66563b61...).
Token strictly binds approved provider string.
Mode == 'live' immediately triggers persistent hard-stop. Only 'paper_simulated' permitted.
Max gross leverage <= 1.0x, max single-position <= 50% immutable.
Cryptographic nonce cache blocks duplicate token reuse.
Hard stop writes .v30_stage2h_b_hard_stop_state.json to disk; survives process restart until manual owner reset.
Monotonic sequence numbers and rolling HMACs block retroactive event tampering.
os.path.realpath resolves canonical paths; blocks traversal outside workspace and any tiingo_cache observation >= 2022-01-01.

network_isolation_boundary_disclosure.python_socket_interception: Blocks in-process socket.connect calls from Python standard and third-party libraries (requests, urllib, httpx).
network_isolation_boundary_disclosure.os_subprocess_limitation: Monkey-patching does NOT guarantee kernel-level network isolation against spawned OS binaries (curl, powershell).
network_isolation_boundary_disclosure.production_recommendation: For true forward evaluation isolation, owner must configure OS-level firewall rules or run inside an air-gapped container.

INFORMATIONAL.events: Normal causal rebalances, opening fill confirmations, 0.0000 cash residual reconciliations.
INFORMATIONAL.response: Logged to append-only immutable audit trail; zero operator action required.

WARNING.events: Execution slippage 10-25 bps, data provider latency 1-5 min, upcoming corporate action within 3 days, rate limit usage > 80%.
WARNING.response: Operator warning emitted; recorded in diagnostic journal; execution continues.

CRITICAL.events: Cash residual $0.0001-$0.01, single-day drawdown > 3%, data provider timeout after 3 retries, stale data > 15 min, late event arrival.
CRITICAL.response: Quarantine affected event; freeze pending rebalances; same-day operator investigation required.

HARD_STOP.events: Unauthorized activation, protected source hash mismatch, balance-sheet residual > $0.01, negative cash balance, Tier 3 access attempt, D2 drawdown lagging E0 by > 300 bps.
HARD_STOP.response: Immediate process halt; persistent disk lock written; zero orders emitted; requires manual owner override key to reset.
